verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms an official AWS Pricing Calculator at calculator.aws, which covers the 'estimate a stack before signing' half of the story, but only as a bare title with no description of how it works. Nothing in the pack documents public per-service pricing pages. A community comment calling AWS pricing opaque is general sentiment, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages, documentation of how the calculator estimates a multi-service stack, independent or hands-on corroboration of estimate accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything
